from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialExpense(BaseModel):
    """A specific expense line item extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    filing_company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed the report")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The description of the expense line item as written in the report (e.g. 'General and administrative expenses')")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The expense amount as written, including currency symbols if present")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the expense figure (e.g. 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expenses: list[FinancialExpense]
